docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Preparar entorn:
docs.text:
Primerament es vorà com contruir des de VSCode

Instalar python

En un powerwhell , executar : 

Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser

vscode: instalar extensions python (oficial)

Crear carpeta de projecte (mark7)

Obrir carpeta des de vscode

Crear venv (ctrl-Shift-P python: create environment )

Usar .venv (ctrl-Shift-P python: set project environment )

Obrir terminal ( ctrl-Shift-ñ )

python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip

pip install mkdocs==1.5.3 mkdocs-material

docs.title: Crear projecte de mkdocs
docs.text:
mkdocs new  mi-web
cd mi-web
mkdocs serve

i obrir en el navegador: http://127.0.0.1:8000

"hola mon" funcionant….

Ja podem tancar el "mkdocs serve"

docs.title: Publicar en GitJub
docs.text:
1. Prepara clau  :   ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "iborra.enrique@gmail.com"
2. Puja a github :  https://github.com/settings/keys   (C&P el text de la clau .pub) demana passphrase!
3. Canvia repositori:  git remote set-url origin git@github.com:EnriqueIborra/mark.git 
4. Crea un repositori en GitHub.
5. Puja el projecte:

docs.title: Dins de la carpeta mi-web
docs.text:
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Primera versio"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/tuusuario/tu-repo.git
git push -u origin main
mkdocs gh-deploy     (demana passphrase)

Llest ! 🎉 Tens la teua web pública en:

https://tuusuario.github.io/tu-repo/
